% The index and glossary files beside the document are current, as an
% Overleaf zip or an arXiv source ships them, and the document sorts
% neither: \makeindex is commented out, and glossaries has no
% \makeglossaries. The document has one LaTeX error of its own,
% \undefinedcs, and the build folder holds a .idx of an earlier build that
% had \makeindex. The page's index and glossary are read from the files
% beside the document. Built by a job of test/run.mjs, as the error would
% fail the generic checks.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{makeidx}
%\makeindex
\usepackage{glossaries}
\newglossaryentry{fruit}{name={fruit},description={the seed-bearing part of a plant}}
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple} is a \gls{fruit}.\undefinedcs
\printindex
\printglossary
\end{document}
